posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I've finally had to accept reality - there are just too many cards in this game for me to store them all in my cutesey custom card boxes.  The amount of room they took up was acceptible before given how much I loved the boxes, but it's been reaching the straining point for a while, and now it's broken through.  So this weekend I got a 4-lane white baseball card box and all the cards in the game fit nicely in there stored vertically, separated by the custom vertical dividers jagarciao and tracerbullet have created, which I've got hosted on my site.  They actually only take up three of the lanes so I can fit some tokens and oversized cards in that third lane, at least until the final expansion comes out.  No idea how many/what types of cards will be coming in that.

I'll still keep posting templates for card boxes (when I get the art) for people who still use them, and I still think they're the bee's knees, but now I have a box full of unused boxes in my den.  It's a fitting meta-tribute to a bygone era when decks had boxes and the living was easy. (sob)

posts.name: DerpTheBugbear
posts.cooked:
What I've been using for dividers is HikariStarshine's Vertical Dividers (he's on BoardgameGeek): https://boardgamegeek.com/article/18489341#18489341

They were made with Printer Studio in mind.  Print on Tarot sized cards, then cut off black portion on the bottom of each. Works really well for those white BCW boxes.

He even has dividersfor the promos I believe.  He also has dividers for all the Cauldron fan-expansion content, but I haven't really looked into that stuff, and probably wont till after the final SotM expansion anyways.

posts.name: inkomo
posts.cooked: For those of you that are crazy like me and keep them in dragon shield sleeves (or other thick sleeves), I have boxes to hold your decks. I have them hosted here for the moment https://boardgamegeek.com/images/user/1051432/inkomo . I am currently working on the rest of them, getting clean images of the hero/villain/environment names is what takes the longest. Also images for the hero/environment boxes are taking longer as http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.com/multiverse is not up to date with the current releases (I completely understand for this to be a very low priority). I have templates set up so that once I have what I need, I can complete them fast. I do have a credits listed for anything that is not my original work, so please keep the pdf files as they are if you redistribute them so the original effort done by other people is still acknowledged.
